title: Understanding Stochastic Gradient Descent
text: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is a variant of gradient descent where the gradient is estimated using a single data point or a small batch of data points. This can lead to noisy updates, which might not always point directly towards the true minimum.

title: Characteristics of SGD
text: SGD is known for its ability to escape local minima due to its noisy updates. This characteristic can be beneficial in finding a global minimum in non-convex optimization problems.
